dct_creator_sm: Issifu, Nurudeen (University of Waterloo). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0004-8612-1707
dct_description_sm: This dataset contains the supplementary materials associated with Chapter 2 of the MA thesis Planning Edible Landscaping in Residential Development: Feasibility, Approval Pathways, and Stakeholder Assessments in the Canadian Context. Chapter 2 presents a scoping review examining the planning, design, development, and governance conditions affecting the feasibility of edible landscaping in residential development. The supplementary materials include the review protocol and documented deviations, database and grey-literature search strategies, screening and eligibility procedures, source-level characteristics of the included evidence, design-feasibility extraction matrices, policy and development-approval matrices, development-stage lock-in classifications, operations and maintenance governance matrices, and the data extraction and codebook framework.
dct_title_s: Supplementary Materials for Planning Edible Landscaping in Residential Development: Feasibility, Approval Pathways, and Stakeholder Assessments in the Canadian Context
